subject: CFNumberGetTypeID

observation.summary: CFNumberGetTypeID and its core CFNumber entry points appear in the export trie of the macOS 27.0 (build 26A5388g) arm64e CoreFoundation image, UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692, which exports 3098 symbols. The sibling rows in the excerpt are the matching accessor/create calls for the same boxed family, so the CFNumber handle ABI is linkable end to end.

claim: CFNumberGetTypeID is an exported symbol of the macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation image, establishing CFNumber as a linkable boxed-type ABI alongside the other CFNumber accessors shown in the excerpt.
reproducer:
CF=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation
dyld_info -uuid "$CF"            # expect UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692
dyld_info -exports "$CF" | grep -E '[[:space:]]_CFNumber(GetTypeID|Create|GetValue)$'
